# FG-INT-0016

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`integrations`](../../ops/runbooks/integrations.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `binding_second_kanflow_project_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このリポジトリの結びつけは、今の結びつけと両立しません。コードを持つリポジトリは 1 つの kanflow のプロジェクトにだけ結べます。先に今の結びつけを解除するか、設定を見直してください。
- en: This binding conflicts with the repository's current bindings: a repository with code is bound to one kanflow project only. Remove the current binding first, or check the setting.
- id: Ikatan ini bertentangan dengan ikatan repositori saat ini: repositori berisi kode hanya dapat diikat ke satu proyek kanflow. Lepaskan ikatan saat ini terlebih dahulu, atau periksa pengaturannya.

## 原因 (cause)

A bind or a binding change broke the binding rules of a forge project (M3 X3, plan 03 §7.1, 02 §2: `PBI-123` must resolve in one kanflow project): a binding that resolves work items (`resolves_work_items = true`, a repository with code) is its project's only binding (partial unique index `integration_bindings_one_resolving_per_project`; "only" is checked by the command under the project row lock); a binding that does not resolve (a shared spec repository) may be one of several of its project but never next to a resolving one; one kanflow project once per (integration, project) (`integration_bindings_one_per_external_project`); and a binding's `resolves_work_items` only goes from false to true (true to false would leave the work item links I1b made). The binding is not moved or changed silently. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` — `bound_to_other_integration` / `bound_to_other_external_project` (the project has a resolving binding), `shared_bindings_present` (a resolving bind or change while other bindings exist), `bound_with_other_setting` (this kanflow project is bound with the other setting), `resolution_fixed` (a change from resolving to shared) — with `project_id`, `integration_id` (the requested one) and `bound_integration_id`, and `action=IntegrationBindingManage`; never the kanflow project ids. `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/integration-bindings` shows the project's bindings; `GET /api/v1/integrations/{id}/bindings?kanflow_project_id=` a kanflow project's.

## 対処 (fix)

If the repository with code really moves to another kanflow project, remove its binding first (`DELETE /api/v1/integrations/{id}/bindings/{binding_id}` or `DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}/integration-bindings/{integration_id}`), then bind it again (runbook integrations). A shared spec repository is bound with `settings.resolves_work_items: false`; to make it the code repository of one kanflow project, remove its other bindings, then `PATCH …/bindings/{binding_id}` with `true`. To stop resolving, remove the binding and bind it again as shared. Binding the same repository to the same kanflow project with the same setting again is not an error (it answers `unchanged`).
